title: Software Engineering Basics
why_it_matters: Software engineering fundamentals are asked in every technical interview. Know SDLC, testing, and design basics.

misconceptions.signature: Student thinks testing is only manual and not part of engineering.
Student thinks only waterfall model exists.

captain_byte.intro: Software engineering is systematic development. SDLC guides the process. Testing ensures quality.
wrong: Testing is part of engineering, not an afterthought.
Agile is iterative; waterfall is sequential.
captain_byte.after_break: You found the SE error. Now fix the model or phase.
captain_byte.after_mastery: You can now reason about software engineering. That's interview-ready CS skill.
captain_byte.retry_prompt: Try again. Check the SDLC phase before answering.

steps.narration: SDLC phases: Requirements, Design, Implementation, Testing, Deployment, Maintenance.
Unit, integration, system, acceptance — testing levels.

interaction.explanation: Unit testing checks individual components in isolation.

discover.conclusion: SDLC guides development. Testing has multiple levels. Agile is iterative. Waterfall is sequential. Version control tracks changes.

understand: SDLC models: Waterfall, Agile, Spiral, Iterative. Testing levels: unit, integration, system, acceptance. Version control tracks code changes. Code review improves quality.

manipulate.prompt: What is the purpose of unit testing?

build.prompt: List the six SDLC phases in order.
build.answer: Requirements, Design, Implementation, Testing, Deployment, Maintenance

break_step.prompt: A student says testing happens after deployment. What is wrong?
break_step.correct_reasoning: Testing happens before deployment in standard SDLC.

transfer.prompt: A team needs fast releases and customer feedback. Which model?
transfer.explanation: Agile supports iterative releases and continuous feedback.

practice.prompt: Which testing level tests the full system?
practice.explanation: System testing validates the complete integrated system.

practice.prompt: Practice 1: Apply Software Engineering to solve this problem.
practice.explanation: This demonstrates Software Engineering in a placement context.

proof.prompt: Explain the difference between unit testing and integration testing.
proof.correct: Unit tests individual components. Integration tests interactions between components.
proof.explanation: Unit is isolated. Integration checks combined behavior.

proof.prompt: Prove your Software Engineering skill: explain the solution to this problem.
proof.explanation: This tests understanding of Software Engineering.

proof_questions.prompt: TCS: What is the difference between black-box and white-box testing?
proof_questions.correct: Black-box tests functionality without internal knowledge. White-box tests internal structures.

srs_key_points: Waterfall is sequential. Agile is iterative.
Testing levels: unit, integration, system, acceptance.
